mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 9.5% triggers a labor market stress signal, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 9.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) coupled with falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a dual expansionary signal, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The combined GDPC1/FEDFUNDS effect does not produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate amplifies market optimism, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the FEDFUNDS drop.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening supply-side growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the GDP demand index (GDPC1) above 13,000 triggers a growth acceleration signal, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 13,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 crossing above 13,000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate reduces growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during a tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS rise.
